defects: The shopping cart icon badge in the top right shows '0' even though there are 3 items (total quantity 4) in the cart.
The 'Grand Total' row under 'Cart Total' has very low contrast (light grey text on a white background), making it hard to read and appearing faded or disabled compared to 'Total products'.
